nodes.title: Analytical Noise-Variance Assessment of Receiver-Side Optical Filtering for Background-Noise Mitigation in Free-Space Optical Communication under Atmospheric Turbulence
nodes.venue: EAI Endorsed Transactions on Transportation Systems and Ocean Engineering
nodes.venue_abbr: EAI Endorsed Transactions on Transportation Systems and Ocean Engineering
nodes.summary: 摘要报告：研究FSO接收端光滤波在信号衰减与噪声抑制间的折中。在OptiSystem中分析40 Gbps、1.54 km、1552.52 nm链路下六种滤波响应：IIR、高斯与贝塞尔响应使Q因子从6.94升至8.81–8.94、SNR从16.83升至18.90–19.03 dB；在固定增益解释下推断有效方差下降45.81–46.50%，但背景噪声分量未被单独识别。近10⁻¹⁹误码率为分析器估计。作者明确指出固定损耗信道假设，并承认户外验证与原始滤波器设置恢复仍属必需。
